newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lerwill joins Hongkong Telecom board.
newsitem.headline: Lerwill joins Hongkong Telecom board.

text.p: Robert Lerwill has been appointed to the board of Hongkong Telecommunications Ltd and Jonathan Solomon has retired, the company said on Thursday.

Lerwill, who joined Hongkong Telecom's parent, Cable & Wireless Plc as executive director, finance, in January, was appointed a non-executive director of Hongkong Telecom, the company said in a statement
It also said Solomon had retired from Hongkong Telecom with immediate effect, and was now a special advisor to the board of Cable & Wireless.
Hongkong Telecom said the board had also formalised the appointment of Roy Wilson as executive director.
